title: Realtime
description: Practices for deadline-driven and scheduled systems.

practices.title: Deadlines are explicit
practices.statement: Every task names its deadline and period; code without a deadline cannot be validated.

practices.title: Bounded worst-case execution
practices.statement: Time-critical paths have bounded worst-case execution; unbounded loops are defects.

practices.title: Protect shared priorities
practices.statement: Shared resources used across priorities need priority inheritance or ceiling protocols.

practices.title: Define queue overflow policy
practices.statement: Define overflow behavior for every queue under burst, including backpressure or drop policy.
